highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.2 backports six upstream Skia security fixes and restores WebAssembly builds that link C sources.
highlights_body: Managed APIs, the C API and the native ABI are unchanged.

bullets.detail: Backports fixes for a Graphite clip render-step overflow (CVE-2026-126871) and skewed elliptical rounded-rectangle geometry in Ganesh, whose radii are now clamped (CVE-2026-126882).

Backports fixes for 64-bit image-filter unique IDs (CVE-2026-118340), SkSL invalid-type rejection (CVE-2026-119261), a region-builder out-of-bounds write (CVE-2026-121086) and an analytic antialiasing blitter heap overflow (CVE-2026-126912).

bullets.lead: WebAssembly apps linking C sources build again
bullets.detail: The WebGPU C++ bindings are now compiled into libSkiaSharp.a, so WebAssembly apps that add their own native C sources, such as Uno Platform 7, link successfully.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Backported the upstream Skia security fixes and the WebAssembly WebGPU link fix to the 4.155 servicing line.

v4.155.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.2 backports upstream Skia fixes and restores WebAssembly builds that link C sources.
v4.155.2.body: It includes GPU geometry, SkSL, region and blitter corrections from upstream Skia. Managed APIs are unchanged.
